title: Kingston Fury Beast 64GB (2x32GB) 5600MT/s CL36 DDR5 Expo RAM $447.58 Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:

[Blu2] 100 years ago these were basically free though…..
[Binchcken07] Not sure it is 32gb * 2 or 16GB * 2, Cause the option is 32GB * 2 with 447$

[TaurusHead] For a bit hallucinated, whether 32x2 remains 32GB RAM altogether.
Looks like I've been spending a lot of time in TrueNas mirrored storage.
[Yanoflies] What's the rule of thumb for figuring out if they'll work as a set of 4? e.g. whether buying 2 sets of these would let you use them as 1 set of 4.
[Agret] For DDR5 running 4 sticks of anything is a gamble.
From what I hear the motherboards are very picky, if my PC gets unplugged for awhile it has to retrain the RAM on next boot and that takes like 2 minutes just for 2 sticks.
[nigel deborah] AMD don't like 4x ddr5 , not sure about Intel
[BROKENKEYBOARD] I think in general as long as it's compatible with 2 of them, then using 4 should also work. The problem is you'd likely have to run it at much slower speeds and memory training can be significantly longer.
[nasesco72] any deals on single stick of UDIMM 32GB DDR5?
